children: mPerps, Canton Network's first perpetuals trading venue, is live and routes trades across perpetuals decentralized exchanges through one interface. Aster is the initial execution venue, giving users a single access point for trades placed across the connected perp DEXs.

The launch adds perpetuals trading as a new DeFi use case on Canton Network. By aggregating venues behind one interface, mPerps can direct trading activity and related transactions toward the network instead of requiring users to navigate separate perp DEXs.
That use case gives the chain a direct connection to activity from the application, but the scale of any network effect depends on whether traders adopt the aggregator over time.

title: Canton: mPerps launches perpetuals trading - 29 Aug 2026
